project: Rails joins on: and as: support

cards.title: Basic joins(:table, on: { col: :col }) support
cards.description: Add the ability to pass on: to joins for explicit table joins with custom ON conditions. Supports symbol values (base table column refs) and literal values (strings, numbers, booleans).
acceptance_criteria: Post.joins(:comments, on: { post_id: :id }).to_sql produces INNER JOIN "comments" ON "comments"."post_id" = "posts"."id"
Post.joins(:comments, on: { post_id: :id, type: 'SpecialComment' }).to_sql produces AND condition
Chaining with association joins works: Post.joins(:author).joins(:comments, on: { post_id: :id })
Returns correct records (not just SQL verification)
Existing joins behavior unchanged (symbol=association, string=SQL, hash=nested associations)
Test file: test/cases/associations/explicit_join_test.rb
cards.implementation_notes: Modify joins! to detect when last arg is Hash with :on key. Pop the opts hash + table name. Add private build_explicit_join method that creates Arel::Nodes::InnerJoin with Arel::Nodes::On. Store resulting Arel node in joins_values — build_join_buckets already routes Arel::Nodes::Join to the join_node bucket.

cards.title: Add as: table aliasing support
cards.description: Add as: option for table aliasing, enabling self-joins and joining the same table multiple times with different conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Comment.joins(:comments, as: :parents, on: { id: :parent_id }).to_sql produces INNER JOIN "comments" "parents" ON "parents"."id" = "comments"."parent_id"
Same table joined twice with different aliases works: Post.joins(:comments, as: :c1, on: { post_id: :id, type: 'Comment' }).joins(:comments, as: :c2, on: { post_id: :id, type: 'SpecialComment' })
ON conditions reference the alias, not the original table name
as: without on: is rejected (ArgumentError)
Tests for all above
cards.implementation_notes: Extend build_explicit_join: when as: is present, use Arel::Table.new(table_name).alias(table_alias). The TableAlias node's [] operator delegates to the underlying table, so ON conditions automatically reference the alias.

cards.title: Rich predicate support in ON conditions
cards.description: Extend the ON condition hash to support nil (IS NULL), arrays (IN), ranges (BETWEEN/>=), and Arel attributes (cross-table references).
acceptance_criteria: on: { deleted_at: nil } produces IS NULL
on: { label: [0, 1] } produces IN (0, 1)
on: { label: 1..5 } produces BETWEEN 1 AND 5
on: { label: 1.. } produces >= 1 (open-ended range)
on: { post_id: Comment.arel_table[:id] } produces cross-table equality
Tests for each predicate type
cards.implementation_notes: Extend build_explicit_join case statement: Array → attribute.in(value), Range → attribute.between(value), nil falls through to attribute.eq(nil) which the visitor renders as IS NULL. Arel attributes/nodes pass through to eq() unchanged since Arel's quoted_node handles them.

cards.title: left_joins / left_outer_joins with on: and as:
cards.description: Extend left_joins and left_outer_joins to support on: and as: options, producing LEFT OUTER JOIN with custom ON conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Post.left_joins(:comments, on: { post_id: :id }).to_sql produces LEFT OUTER JOIN
Post.left_outer_joins(:comments, on: { post_id: :id }) produces same SQL (alias)
as: works with left joins
Left join returns all base records including those without matches
unscope(:left_outer_joins) removes the on: left join
unscope(:joins) does NOT remove the on: left join
Tests for all above
cards.implementation_notes: Modify left_outer_joins! with same detection pattern. Store Arel::Nodes::OuterJoin in left_outer_joins_values (not joins_values) so unscope(:left_outer_joins) works correctly. Modify build_join_buckets: the block processing left_outer_joins_values currently raises on non-Hash/Symbol/Array — add Arel::Nodes::Join handling to route to join_node bucket.

cards.title: Composition: chaining, merge, includes interaction
cards.description: Verify and test that on: joins compose correctly with all other query methods.
acceptance_criteria: Chain on: join with association join: Post.joins(:author).joins(:comments, on: { post_id: :id })
Chain multiple on: joins together
merge() preserves on: joins from both relations (same model)
merge() works cross-model with on: joins
includes(:assoc) + joins(:table, on: ...) does NOT trigger eager loading
eager_load works alongside on: joins
except(:joins) removes inner on: joins
on: joins work with where, select, group, order, distinct, count
Tests for all above
cards.implementation_notes: Mostly testing — the existing pipeline should handle these cases without code changes. merger.rb already partitions non-Hash/Symbol/Array into others and re-adds them. includes interaction works because Arel nodes are not in joined_includes_values (which is includes_values & joins_values — Arel nodes never match symbols). If any tests fail, fix the implementation.

cards.title: Error handling and edge cases
cards.description: Add robust error handling and test edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: joins(on: { post_id: :id }) without table name raises ArgumentError with clear message
joins(:comments, on: {}) with empty hash raises ArgumentError
joins(:comments, on: 'not a hash') raises ArgumentError
joins(:comments, as: :c) without on: raises ArgumentError
joins(123, on: { ... }) with non-symbol/string table raises ArgumentError
Tests for all error cases
cards.implementation_notes: Add validation in build_explicit_join and at the detection point in joins!/left_outer_joins!. Follow Rails convention: raise ArgumentError with descriptive messages.

cards.title: Documentation and CHANGELOG
cards.description: Add RDoc to public methods and CHANGELOG entry.
acceptance_criteria: RDoc on joins method includes on: and as: examples with SQL output
RDoc on left_outer_joins method includes on: and as: examples
CHANGELOG entry at top of activerecord/CHANGELOG.md following Rails format
CHANGELOG includes code examples showing the feature
cards.implementation_notes: Follow Rails RDoc conventions: # comments, +code+ for inline refs, indented code examples with SQL output in comments. CHANGELOG: *   prefix, 4-space indent body, fenced code blocks, *Author Name* attribution.
